description: Read one buyer intent across every check made under its intent_id: the intent as recorded (source, merchant, maximum, currency, expiry, the evidence hash, and verified, false until Last Price can check the evidence), how many checks were allowed, denied or asked about, and how much of the maximum is held, spent and left. Use it before the next purchase under the same intent. An agent key sees only its own checks. Only where the workspace has intents switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_purchase_intent
